proposals: The Department of Fisheries should publish PM-MKSSY spending by component on the NFDP dashboard each month — amount approved, released and actually paid, so the roughly ₹4.73 crore reaching beneficiaries against a ₹6,000 crore outlay is tracked publicly rather than surfacing only in Parliament answers.

The Department of Fisheries should issue a corrigendum to the Rajya Sabha annexure titled 'Support Provided to Small and Micro Fisheries Enterprises', stating what its 20,09,341 total actually counts, since NFDP's own data show only 21,998 organisation registrations nationally.

The Department of Fisheries should bring the PMMSY public dashboard up to date with state-wise sanctions and releases through FY2025–26, so it matches the figures given to Parliament instead of stopping at FY2021–22.

The Department of Fisheries should quote NFDP registration counts in Parliament answers with a timestamp taken from the live counter, so two answers a day apart do not give 35.92 lakh and 35.85 lakh for the same figure without explanation.

The Department of Fisheries and Tamil Nadu's Fisheries Department should publish, state by state, the number of vessels required to hold an EEZ Access Pass and the applications received on ReALCRaft, so Tamil Nadu's 6 passes against Karnataka's 2,563 can be read against eligible fleet size.
